Another *very* rough draft:

This section will connect the SIR models and tree shapes into the framework of phylodynamics. Explains how the evolution of a pathogen relates to its transmission

Basic phylodynamics definition: the interdisciplinary study of how epidemiological, immunological, and evolutionary processes interact to shape the genetic trees (phylogenies) of pathogens over time and space (Wikipedia)

- Combines rapid pathogen evolution (mutations happening over days or months) with host population dynamics (spread, immunity, and behavior) (ScienceDirect.com)
